stein-making-americans.year: 1925 (IA metadata; title page names Contact Editions, Three Mountains Press, Paris, no year seen)
stein-making-americans.evidence: djvu first 1500 chars read; collection internetarchivebooks, not lending
stein-making-americans.case: Bloom lists The Making of Americans; the complete 1925 Contact Editions (Paris) text is on IA.
stein-making-americans.note: Paris-printed (Three Mountains Press); 'COPYRIGHTED BY THE AUTHOR' with no year in the part I read -- the 1925 date is from IA metadata. A 1925 publication is PD in the US either way. It is enormous (900+ pp); OCR quality at the start is poor around the title page but the body reads clean. The 1934 Harcourt abridgment is NOT PD.

stein-tender-buttons.case: Bloom lists Tender Buttons (1914). PG has it.
